The full dataset is over 99.9% attack traffic (benign flows are 129,437 of 30,420,086 rows, 0.43%), an order of magnitude more skewed than most NIDS datasets; a uniform row-level sample may carry very few or zero benign rows, and a classifier's accuracy on this data mostly reflects its attack-vs-attack discrimination, not its ability to recognize normal traffic.
